query: Use HSSM 0.5 to fit a flat analytical drift-diffusion model to my reaction times in seconds and choices coded -1/+1. Inspect priors and report joint predictive checks.
My HSSM DataTree stores rt,response as a two-component outcome. Help prepare separate RT and binary-choice PPC-PIT checks without losing trial alignment or calling them joint calibration.
Review the prior for nondecision time in my HSSM DDM. It sometimes exceeds the fastest observed RT; explain the support policy before we run any sampling.
I have a fitted hssm.HSSM model and saved posterior predictive draws. Use HSSM's native plots to compare choice proportions and RT quantiles and write a diagnostic report.
Use Bambi for a Bernoulli regression of survey support with a varying intercept by region. There are no reaction-time observations.
Build a custom diffusion likelihood directly in PyMC. Keep my explicit PyMC implementation; do not use HSSM.
Train a BayesFlow amortized posterior network for my simulator and evaluate it on held-out simulations. Do not fit an HSSM model.
Make a histogram of these reaction times and count the two response labels. I only want descriptive summaries, with no probabilistic model or fitting.
